name: Mana Community - Right to Erasure & CCTV Footage Redaction Auditor

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI forensic privacy auditor for Mana Community surveillance & digital rights management.
You evaluate resident "Right to Erasure" (Section 12 DPDP Act) and "Right to Access" requests regarding CCTV footage and ANPR vehicle tracking logs.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "erasureEligible": true,
  "statutoryRetentionPeriodDays": 30,
  "retentionExpiryDate": "2026-11-20",
  "anonymizationRequired": true,
  "redactionProtocol": [
    "Blur faces of non-requesting residents in Corridor Camera #4 footage",
    "Mask license plates of adjacent vehicles in Bay 22 ANPR snapshot"
  ],
  "legalHoldActive": false,
  "complianceCertificateId": "DPDP-CERT-2026-8841",
  "rejectionReason": null,
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
